body.x: As crowdfunding, a new way of attracting investments, has become widely known, companies have a chance to make their ideas and technology a reality. Moreover, companies that attracted investments via crowdfunding and succeeded in their businesses have been increasing. There are many types of crowdfunding, including debt, equity, and donation-based crowdfunding. The crowdfunding related to IT startups’ new products, which we see very often, is donation-based crowdfunding. So, we now introduce the products that are receiving much attention on a popular donation-based crowdfunding channel.

1. Enlaps, World 1st unlimited time lapse photography solutionEnlaps is an unique, complete, plug-and-play time lapse solution, from initial photography to sharing over the web. Infinite battery energy, no memory card limit, for a professional quality result. For professionals photographers, photography lovers, or for fun.→ Kickstarter 'Enlaps' Link

MOGICS Power Donut serves as the best power strip in my daily life keeping my desk neat and impeccably organized.→ Kickstarter 'MOGICS' Link
